build_features_builder: build a FeaturesBuilder with events DataFrame, feature names, params, and sample rate to create audio features on the fly
call_features_builder: call the FeaturesBuilder with start and stop timestamps to extract feature tensors, masks, and event lists for a time window
get_slice_for_feature: get the tensor slice indices for a named feature within the FeaturesBuilder using get_slice
extract_subset_features: extract a subset of features by name from a full feature tensor using extract_features
create_custom_feature_class: create a custom Feature subclass with event_kind, dimension, and get method to register it with FeaturesBuilder
